item_short_desc: Unwind and enjoy the outdoors with Rothco’s Super Hammock, a robust and spacious hammock designed for ultimate relaxation. Crafted from durable nylon rope, this hammock is built to last, capable of supporting up to an impressive 881 pounds. Measuring 20 feet in length and 5 feet in width, it offers ample space for you to sit or lie down comfortably. Whether you're at a campsite, in your backyard, or on a hiking adventure, this outdoor hammock provides a reliable and comfortable spot to relax.
